# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityATRTailTrailingTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True
        self._equity = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._atr = self.atr(self._equity.symbol, 14, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.plot_indicator("ATR", self._atr)
        self._high = 0
        self._invested = False

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not self._atr.is_ready:
            return
        bar = data.bars.get(self._equity)
        if not bar:
            return
        # If not invested, we will invest 100% of the portfolio.
        if not self._invested:
            self.set_holdings(self._equity, 1)
            self._invested = True
        # We will use the price multiplied by a factor of 3 as the stop loss.
        # It means that if the price drops by 3 times the ATR value, we will exit.
        stop_loss_price = bar.close - (self._atr.current.value * 3)
        # If the price is above the stop loss, we will keep the position.
        # If the price is below the stop loss, we will exit the position.
        if bar.close > self._high and bar.close > stop_loss_price:
            pass
        elif bar.close < self._high and bar.close < stop_loss_price:
            self.liquidate(self._equity)
            self._invested = False
        self._high = max(self._high, bar.close)
